routines.comparison_level: complete 16 MiB RAM and all GPR/SR/PR/PC state against retail SH-4 interpreter at callback entry
routines.scope: Load argument and callback-slot address from this wrapper’s literals, dereference callback through R0, and tail-jump while preserving PR.
limitations: Callback body behavior is outside this ten-byte wrapper.
Differential verification uses the project SH-4 interpreter, not Dreamcast hardware or whole-game execution.
